Ailin,

I'm not sure why you are getting this memory issues, your machine has enough RAM memory to run 30 combinations. Please, be sure that you are not running other consuming RAM programs (e.g., ArcGIS or a lot of tabs in your browser) when you are running your analysis? You can use the Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) to figure out if other processes are "consuming" your memory RAM.

Best,
Gonzalo
